name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow monorepo root - NestJS API in nestbackend/, React SPA in reactfrontend/
//: DELIBERATELY NOT AN npm WORKSPACE. There is no `workspaces` field here, so
each app keeps its own package.json, its own lockfile and its own
node_modules. That costs some disk and dedup, and buys two things that
1. The backend Dockerfile keeps working UNCHANGED. Workspaces hoist
node_modules and the lockfile to the root, so a build context of
./nestbackend would no longer contain a lockfile and `npm ci` would
fail. Un-hoisting that is a real Dockerfile rewrite.
2. A React SPA and a Nest API share almost no dependencies, so hoisting
The scripts below are pure convenience wrappers. `npm --prefix <dir> run`
runs a script as if you had cd'd into that folder, so nothing here needs
to know anything about either app's internals.

scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix nestbackend ci && npm --prefix reactfrontend ci
